regions.merged_text: 1927 (See note in big book August 4, '27) Mary (Mrs. ) Knapp - Dia- betic Gangreen: Threatened with loss of leg six yrs. ago. Drs in Ford Hospital insisting on amputation the gangreenous toes at least .. . Enrolled for year August 4th, going to Ford's same evening. Nest day Drs astonished at improvement. However one Doct'r under- took to peal one of the bad toes and inflamation started at once .. so bad next day - thus saving of leg was despaired of ... Daughter comes and enrolles her as a perpetual member. Next day doctors a- gain surprised. Patient discharged shortly afterward.

regions.merged_text: One month To-day same Mrs. Knapp went to Providence Hospital - cov- ered with carbuncles. Hopes of recovery vanished when on Sept. 28 daughter enrolled her again as perpetual member ... Next day said car- buncles were all draining to the astonishment of doctors . Then however, it was decided to help one of them with knife .... All are now healed except the one on which knife was used. Very little hopes now left .... Poor Souls are enrolled for this intention To-day with promise of monthly enrollment for year if patient is spared. Oct. 14 Improvement noticed yesterday .... Daughter going to daily Com. Nov. 7 reports: "Mother coming home this week."
